profile.name: 晶圆探针台
profile.description: 用于半导体晶圆电学测试的探针台，可精确定位晶圆与探针，在测试仪器配合下对晶圆上器件进行接触和测量，常用于参数表征、工艺开发与失效分析。
profile.description_en: A wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer electrical testing. It precisely positions the wafer and probe needles so instruments can contact and measure on-wafer devices, commonly for device characterization, process development, and failure analysis.

A wafer prober used for semiconductor wafer electrical testing. It precisely positions the wafer and probe needles so instruments can contact and measure on-wafer devices, commonly for device characterization, process development, and failure analysis.
